Violence Against Women Act (VAWA).
Title I: Enhancing judicial and law enforcement tools to combat violence against women.
Title II: Improving services for victims of domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking.
Title III: Services, protection, and justice for young victims.
Self-petition: Allows victims of domestic violence who are spouses of U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents to self-petition for immigration status.
